cohort: 100 pregnant women with fibroid tumors larger than 3 cm at the Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology, DMCH, Laheriasarai, Bihar between July 2020 and December 2021.
finding: Most uterine fibroids were asymptomatic during pregnancy, and risk increased with fibroid size, with observed complications including abortion (4%), APH (6%), abdominal discomfort (12%), PROM and premature labor (10%), PPH (20%), FGR (12%), and LBW (12%).
mod_finding: The majority of births (58%) were via cesarean section, and 17.8% of women underwent cesarean myomectomy.
